orgKey.title: PhishClean organisation key
orgKey.description: The key from your PhishClean for Teams admin page (starts with pc_org_). Puts this browser on your organisation's plan: every check on, no sign-up or payment prompts for the user.

trustedDomains.title: Trusted domains
trustedDomains.description: Domains PhishClean never warns about, such as your own sign-in and internal sites (for example corp.example.com). Applies to the domain and its subdomains.
